name: AITC Popup Builder – Scheduled & Multi Popup Manager
author: AITC International

sections.description:
AITC Popup Builder – Scheduled & Multi Popup Manager helps you create beautiful, fast-loading popups without bloating your website.

Whether you want to show promotional offers, announcements, newsletter CTAs, discount banners, or important alerts, Custom Popup gives you full control over design, timing, targeting, and behavior — all from a simple settings panel.

Built with performance in mind, the plugin is lightweight, optimized, and does not rely on heavy external frameworks.

✨ Features:

  • Create image, text, or custom HTML popups
  • Add custom URL link to popup images
  • Set popup delay (time-based trigger)
  • Enable entrance and exit animations
  • Show popup on page load
  • Cookie-based control (show once per user)
  • Choose popup position and overlay style
  • Control popup width and responsiveness
  • Enable or disable popup anytime
  • Works with all themes
  • Fully compatible with Elementor, WPBakery, Gutenberg, and other builders
  • Clean admin interface
  • Lightweight and performance-focused

🚀 Use Cases:

  • Promote special offers and discounts
  • Display announcements or updates
  • Grow email subscribers
  • Highlight featured products
  • Show event promotions
  • Seasonal sales popups
  • Redirect users via clickable popup image
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/aitc-popup-builder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Custom Popup in your dashboard.
  4. Configure popup content, timing, and display options.
  5. Save changes and test on the frontend.
sections.faq:
Can I create an image popup with a clickable link?

Yes. You can upload an image and assign a custom URL that opens when users click the popup image.

Can I control when the popup appears?

Yes. You can set a delay timer or display it immediately on page load.

Can I show the popup only once per visitor?

Yes. Cookie-based display control ensures the popup does not repeatedly appear for the same user.

Is this plugin lightweight?

Yes. Custom Popup is built without heavy libraries and is optimized for fast performance.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. It works with Elementor, WPBakery, Gutenberg, and all major WordPress themes.

Can I disable the popup temporarily?

Yes. You can enable or disable the popup with a single toggle in the settings.
